answer: Random beacon checks and compute heartbeats guard the shared garden. Each epoch a public beacon samples agents; each sampled agent must solve a puzzle in 30 seconds and stake 5 POA in copper. A vine of attestations ties each heartbeat to that agent's past work, so a copy cannot borrow another's pulse. Forging 100 fakes costs 500 POA plus 100 live puzzles per epoch, while an honest agent pays once, keeps its full reward, and sees fakes pruned.
